items.title: Kospi sell-off deepens, Why leveraged ETFs are under fire
items.summary: The KOSPI Composite Index (^KS11) rout continues, prompting South Korea's Finance Minister to apologize for introducing leveraged ETFs. Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor joins Julie Hyman on Market Domination to break down how these high-risk funds work, why they're fueling concern, and the key risks investors should understand.
